# How to Create Image Audio Driven Video with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to generate a talking video from a reference image, driving audio, and prompt text, including setup, request fields,…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_image_audio_driven_video`

## Prompt

```text
Generate a talking video from a reference image, driving audio, and prompt text.
```

## Review before approval

- `prompt_text` (required): Talking prompt text used to guide video generation.
- `prompt_image_file_id` (required): Reference image file id.
- `prompt_audio_file_id` (required): Driving audio file id.
- `resolution` (optional): Prompt image or prompt video frame resize target before generation. Default: 720p.
- `model_id` (optional): Image audio driven video model id. Default: image-audio-driven-video-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
